To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fast transient is TTX sensitive and the slow transient is not.
the electrical properties of small frog atrial trabacula are not those of a simple membrane.

1) in small frog atrial preparations the fast transient inward current is blocked by TTX; 2) the reversal potentials of this current and the slow transient inward current are similar; 3) the fast transient current is not uniform across the preparation; and 4) the specific membrane capacitance of these preparations is approximately 3 muF cm-2.

the fast transient current in this tissue is carried by the usual Na+ channels.
the fast transient current is due to sodium entry, the slow current due to calcium entry and both are blocked by TTX.
